actual: DR snapshot fails with Error response from daemon: No such container: aistock-pg.
closure_requirements: DR snapshot uses an explicit production container configuration and does not fall back to dev DB 5433.
pg_dump custom-format snapshots must not use invalid parallel --jobs.
Dump validation must stream the local dump into pg_restore without a bare pg_restore --list call.
DR validation must parse pg_restore --list table entries emitted by the current pg_restore version.
Dev DB schema drift should remain visible but must not block DR dump validity unless DR_SCHEMA_DIFF_STRICT=1 is set.
Add targeted regression coverage for DR_PG_CONTAINER handling.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: DR snapshot fails with Error response from daemon: No such container: aistock-pg.
evidence_uris: GitHub Issue #636; Nightly run 26883168947; DR job 79288239822; docker ps shows timescaledb on host 5432 and aistock-pg-dev on 5433.
expected: DR snapshot should resolve the canonical production DB container safely from DR_PG_CONTAINER or the running container mapped to prod port 5432, then complete without using dev DB 5433.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
title: DR snapshot uses stale aistock-pg container name and blocks Nightly
